[ PRICING ]

Four editions. A quote that fits.

HR & Payroll is licensed by edition and by the number of employees, branches and users. We quote each company individually.

  • Basic

    Core HR for a single team.

    Request a quote

    Priced by company size

    • Employee records and directory
    • Employee self-service
    • Announcements, policies and recognition
    Talk to the team

  • Standard

    Adds time and offboarding.

    Request a quote

    Priced by company size

    • Everything in Basic
    • Attendance and time tracking
    • Offboarding
    Talk to the team
  • Includes payroll

    Professional

    Adds Philippine payroll.

    Request a quote

    Priced by company size

    • Everything in Standard
    • Payroll runs and payslips
    • SSS, PhilHealth, Pag-IBIG and BIR
    Talk to the team

  • Enterprise

    For multi-branch organisations.

    Request a quote

    Priced by company size

    • Everything in Professional
    • Multi-branch and advanced access control
    • Advanced integrations
    • Recruitment and referrals
    • Single sign-on
    Talk to the team

Each license also sets how many employees, branches and users it covers. Every edition runs on your own infrastructure. Deployment options

[ WHAT SHAPES A QUOTE ]

Three things decide the price.

  • Edition

    Which modules you need — from core HR to payroll and enterprise features.

  • Size

    How many employees, branches and user accounts the license covers.

  • Setup & support

    Installation on your servers, and the help you want getting started and afterwards.
